editorial:
If you grew up loving old-school action movies, this one feels like a reunion of your favorite heroes. Sylvester Stallone leads a crew of legendary tough guys on what starts as a simple job, but things go sideways fast when one of their own is killed. The team heads deep into enemy territory for revenge, and the vibe is loud, proud, and packed with explosions, one-liners, and big personalities. It never takes itself too seriously, which is exactly the point. You get to watch icons like Jason Statham, Dolph Lundgren, and Arnold Schwarzenegger share the screen, and their chemistry carries the whole thing. It is pure popcorn entertainment from start to finish.

The action is big and silly, with shootouts, chases, and fights that keep things moving. The pacing rarely slows down, so you will not get bored. The story is thin and some jokes land better than others, but the fun factor makes up for it. If you want deep drama, look elsewhere. If you want a loud, fun night with friends, this is your pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, the team tracks down the villain Vilain, who has been mining plutonium to sell. After a brutal fight, Barney Ross kills Vilain with a knife and takes back the stolen plutonium. The Expendables then rescue the kidnapped villagers and destroy the mine. The movie ends with the team reunited and joking around, ready for their next mission, with a hint that more adventures are coming.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic action movies and big ensemble casts.
